summary: LGI Homes, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 14, 2026, reporting that on October 9, 2026 it entered into a Seventh Amendment to its Fifth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association as administrative agent and several lenders. The amendment extends maturity to October 9, 2030 for $855 million (73.3% of roughly $1.166 billion of revolving commitments), provides a $175 million incremental facility, and modifies borrowing base values and covenants. No special situation is present; this is a routine credit-facility amendment.
